title: Calibrations close to $\mathrm{G}_2$-twistor space
summary: We study natural structures of the kind of $\mathrm{G}_2$ existing on the unit tangent sphere bundle $SM \rightarrow M$ of any oriented Riemannian 4-manifold $M$. Based on the Harvey-Morgan classification of degree 3 calibrations on $\mathbb{R}^7$, we identity those which can be found on $SM$. We also study the Laplacian of the Sasaki metric on 3-forms.
